senses.gloss:
देव् €1 Ā. (देवते)
—1 To sport, play, gamble.
—2 To lament.
—3 To shine.
—4 To throw, cast. ━With {@परि@} to lament, mourn.

देव a. (-वी f.)
 [दिव्-अच्]
—1 Divine, celestial; Bg. 11. 11; Ms. 12. 117.
—2 Shining; यज्ञस्य देवमृत्विजम् Rv. 1. 1. 1.
—3 Fit to be worshipped or honoured.

देव + .{@-वः@}
—1 A god, deity; एको देवः केशवो वा शिवो वा Bh. 3. 120.
—2
——(a) The god of rain, an epithet of Indra; as in द्वादश वर्षाणि
 देवो न ववर्ष; अवर्षयदेवः Rām. 1. 9. 18; काले च देशे च प्रबवर्ष
 देवः Bu. C. 2. 7.
——(b) A cloud.
—3 A divine man, Brāhmaṇa, as in भूदेव.
—4 A king, ruler, as in मनुष्यदेव; तां देवसमितिं (अभ्यागच्छत्)
 Mb. 3. 130. 22.
—5 A title affixed to the names of Bārhmaṇas; as in गोविन्ददेव, पुरुषोत्तमदेव &c.
—6 (In dramas) A title of honour used in addressing a king, (‘My lord’,
 ‘Your majesty’); ततश्च देव Ve. 4; यथाज्ञापयति देवः &c.
—7 Quicksilver.
—8 The Supreme Spirit; हित्वा च देहं प्रविशन्ति देवं दिवौकसो द्यामिव
 पार्थ सांख्याः Mb. 12. 301. 112.
—9 A fool
—10 A child.
—11 A man following any particular business.
—12 A lover.
—13 Emulation.
—14 Sport, play.
—15 A husbandʼs brother (cf. देवृ, देवर).
—16 A lancer.

देव + .{@-वम्@} An organ of sense; देवानां प्रभवो देवो मनसश्च त्रिलोककृत्
 Mb. 14. 41. 3. [cf. L. deus; Gr. deos].

देव + -अंशः a partial incarnation of god.
देव + -अगारः, -रम् a temple.
देव + -अगारः, -रम् a temple.
देव + -अङ्गना a celestial damsel, an apsaras.

देव + -अतिदेवः, -अधिदेवः
—1 the highest god.
—2 an epithet of (1) Śiva. (2) Buddha. (3) Viṣṇu. देवातिदेवो भगवान्
 प्रसूतिरंशे हरिर्यस्य जगत्प्रणेता Hariv.

देव + -अतिदेवः, -अधिदेवः
—1 the highest god.
—2 an epithet of (1) Śiva. (2) Buddha. (3) Viṣṇu. देवातिदेवो भगवान्
 प्रसूतिरंशे हरिर्यस्य जगत्प्रणेता Hariv.

देव + -अधिपः
—1 an epithet of Indra.
—2 the supreme god.
देव + -अनीकम् an army of celestials.

देव + -अनुचरः, -अनुयायिन् m. an attendant or follower of a god;
 निशम्य देवानुचरस्य वाचं मनुष्यदेवः पुनरप्युवाच R. 2. 52.

देव + -अनुचरः, -अनुयायिन् m. an attendant or follower of a god;
 निशम्य देवानुचरस्य वाचं मनुष्यदेवः पुनरप्युवाच R. 2. 52.

देव + -अभीष्ट a.
—1 liked by or dear to gods.
—2 sacred or dedicated to a deity.
देव + -अभीष्ट + .({@-ष्टा@}) piper betel.
देव + -अरण्यम् the garden of gods, the Nandana garden; अलमुद्द्योतयामासुर्देवारण्यमिवर्तवः R. 10. 80.
देव + -अरिः a demon.

देव + -अर्चनम्, -ना
—1 the worship of gods.
—2 idolatry.

देव + -अर्चनम्, -ना
—1 the worship of gods.
—2 idolatry.

देवनः + .{@-ना@}
—1 Gambling, a game at dice.
—2 Sport, pastime.
—3 Lamentation.

देव + -अर्पणम्
—1 an offering to the god.
—2 the Veda; पृथग्भूतानि चान्यानि यानि देवार्पणानि च Mb. 13. 86. 17 (see com.).
देव + -आवसथः a temple.
देव + -अश्वः an epithet of उच्चैः श्रवस्, the horse of Indra.
देव + -आक्रीडः ‘the garden of the gods’, Nandana garden.

देव + -आजीवः, -आजीविन् m. an attendant upon an idol.
—2 a low Brāhmaṇa subsisting by attendance upon an idol and upon the
 offerings made to it.

देव + -आजीवः, -आजीविन् m. an attendant upon an idol.
—2 a low Brāhmaṇa subsisting by attendance upon an idol and upon the
 offerings made to it.

देव + -आत्मन् a.
—1 consecrated, holy, sacred.
—2 of a
[]
 divine nature. ━(m.)
—1 the divine soul; ते ध्यानयोगानुगता ऽपश्यन् देवात्मशक्तिं स्वगुणैर्निगूढाम्
 Śvet. Up. 1. 3.
—2 the holy fig-tree.

देव + -आयतनम् a temple; Ms. 4. 46; न देवायतनं गच्छेत् कदाचिद्
 वाऽप्रदक्षिणम् । न पीडयेद् वा वस्त्राणि न देवायतनेष्वपि ॥ Kūrma P.

देव + -आयुधम्
—1 a divine weapon.
—2 rainbow.
देव + -आयुषम् the life-time of a god.

देव + -आलयः
—1 heaven.
—2 a temple.

देव + -आवासः
—1 heaven.
—2 the holy fig-tree (अश्वत्थ).
—3 a temple.
—4 the Sumeru mountain.
देव + -आहारः nectar, ambrosia.
देव + -इज् a. (nom. sing. देवेट्-ड्) worshipping the gods.
देव + -इज्यः an epithet of Bṛhaspati, preceptor of the gods.

देव + -इन्द्रः
—1 an epithet of Indra.
—2 of Śiva.
देव + -इष्ट a. dear to gods.
देव + -इष्ट + .({@-ष्टा@}) the wild lime tree.
देव + -इष्ट + .({@-ष्टः@}) bdellium.
देव + -ईशः an epithet of (1) Indra. (2) Śiva. (3) Viṣṇu. (4) Brahman.
देव + -ईशः + .({@-शी@}) N. of Durgā; also of Devakī, mother of Kṛṣṇa.
देव + -ईश्वरः N. of (1) Śiva. (2) Indra.

देव + -उद्यानम्
—1 divine garden.
—2 the Nandana garden.
—3 a garden near a temple.

देव + -ऋषिः (देवर्षिः)
—1 a deified saint, divine sage such as अत्रि, भृगु, पुलस्त्य, अङ्गिरस्
 &c.; एवंवादिनि देवर्षौ Ku. 6. 84 (i. e. अङ्गिरस्); अथ देवऋषी
 राजन् संपरेतं नृपात्मजम् Bhāg.; आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोका देवर्षिपितृमानवाः ।
 तृप्यन्तु पितरः सर्वे मातृमातामहादयाः Tarpaṇamantra.
—2 an epithet of Narada; देवर्षीणां च नारदः Bg. 10. 13, 26.
देव + -ओकस् n. the mountain Meru or Sumeru.
देव + -कन्या a celestial damsel, a nymph; also देवकन्यका.

देव + -कर्दमाः sandal, aloe wood, camphor, saffron pounded together
 and made into a paste.
देव + -काष्ठम् the Devadāru tree.

देव + -किरी N. of a Rāgiṇi; ललिता मालती गौरी नाटी देवकिरी तथा ।
 मेघरागस्य रागिण्यो भवन्तीमाः सुमध्यमाः ॥
देव + -कुटम् a temple.
देव + -कुण्डम् a natural spring.

देव + -कुलम्
—1 a temple.
—2 a race of gods.
—3 a group of gods.
देव + -कुल्या the celestial Ganges.

देव + -कुसुमम् cloves; एलां च देवकुसुमं त्वक्पत्रं देवदारु च
 Śiva B. 30. 14.

देव + -खातम्, -खातकम्
—1 a natural hollow among mountains.
—2 a natural pond or reservoir; Ms. 4. 203.
—3 a pond near a temple. ˚बिल a cavern, chasm.

देव + -खातम्, -खातकम्
—1 a natural hollow among mountains.
—2 a natural pond or reservoir; Ms. 4. 203.
—3 a pond near a temple. ˚बिल a cavern, chasm.
देव + -गणः a class of gods.
देव + -गणिका an apsaras; q. v.

देव + -गतिः the path of देवलोक; अनुज्ञातश्च रामेण ययौ देवगतिं
 मुनिः A. Rām. 2. 1. 40.
देव + -गन्धर्वः an epithet of Nārada.
देव + -गन्धर्वः + .({@-र्वम्@}) a particular mode of singing.
देव + -गर्जनम् thunder.
देव + -गर्भः see हिरण्यगर्भ; Rām. 2. 40. 23.
देव + -गायनः a celestial chorister, a Gandharva.

देव + -गान्धारी N. of a Rāgiṇī; गान्धारी देवगान्धारी मालवी श्रीश्च
 सारवी । रामकीर्यपि रागिण्यः श्रीरागस्य प्रिया इमाः ॥

देव + -गिरिः
—1 N. of a mountain; cf. Me. 44.
—2 N. of a town (Daulatabad).
देव + -गिरी f. N. of a Rāgiṇī.

देव + -गुरुः
—1 an epithet of Kaśyapa (the father of gods).
—2 of Bṛhaspati (the preceptor of gods).
देव + -गुही an epithet of Sarasvatī or of a place situated on it.

देव + -गुह्यम्
—1 a secret only known by gods.
—2 death.

देव + -गृहम्
—1 a temple.
—2 the place of a king.
—3 a planetary sphere.
देव + -ग्रहः a class of demons who causes harmless madness.
देव + -चरितम् the course of action or practices of the gods; न देवचरितं चरेत्.

देव + -चर्या the worship or service of gods.
[]
देव + -चिकित्सकौ (du.) Aśvins, the twin physicians of gods.

देव + -छन्दः a pearl-necklace having 81, 100 or 108 strings; शतमष्टयुतं
 हारो देवच्छन्दो ह्यशीतिरेकयुता Bṛ. S. 81. 32.

देव + -जनः the gods collectively. ˚विद्या the science of music,
 dance, other arts &c.; Ch. Up. 7. 1. 2.
देव + -जातम् a class of gods.
देव + -जामिः f. a sister of the gods; देवजामीनां पुत्रोऽसि Av. 6. 46. 1.

देव + -तरुः
—1 the holy fig-tree.
—2 one of the trees of paradise. (i. e. मन्दार, पारिजात, सन्तान,
 कल्प and हरिचन्दन); पञ्चैते देवतरवो मन्दारः पारिजातकः ।
 सन्तानः कल्पवृक्षश्च पुंसि वा हरिचन्दनम् ॥ Ak.
—3 the tree in a village (चैत्यवृक्ष) where the villagers usually
 meet (Mar. पार).
देव + -तर्पणम् offerings of water, part of the सन्ध्या ceremony.

देव + -ताडः
—1 fire.
—2 an epithet of Rāhu.

देव + -तातः
—1 a sacrifice.
—2 N. of Kaśyapa.

देव + -तातिः
—1 a god.
—2 divine service; स नो यक्षद् देवताता यजीयान् Rv. 3. 19. 1.

देव + -तीर्थम्
—1 the right moment for the worship of gods.
—2 the tips of the fingers sacred to gods.

देव + -दत्त a.
—1 god-given, granted by the gods.
—2 given to the gods (as a village, &c.).

देव + -दत्त + .({@-त्तः@})
—1 N. of the conch-shell of Arjuna; देवदत्तं धनञ्जयः (दध्मौ) Bg. 1. 15.
—2 a certain person (used in speaking of men indefinitely); मुक्तस्ततो

 पीनो देवदत्तो दिवा न भुङ्क्ते &c.
—3 one of the vital airs exhaled in yawning; देवदत्तो विजृम्भणे.
 ˚अग्रजः N. of Buddha.
देव + -दर्शन a. visiting the gods.
देव + -दर्शन + .({@-नः@}) N. of Nārada; यथा प्राह नारदो देवदर्शनः Bhāg. 2. 8. 1.

देव + -दारु m., n. a species of pine; गङ्गाप्रवाहोक्षितदेवदारु

देव + -दासः a servant or attendant upon a temple.

देव + -दासः + .({@-सी@})
—1 a female in the service of gods or a temple.
—2 a courtezan (employed as a dancer in a temple).
—3 the wild citron tree.
देव + -दीपः the eye.

देव + -दुन्दुभिः

देवयानी N. of the daughter of Śukra, preceptor of the Asuras.
 [She fell in love with Kacha, her fatherʼs pupil, but he rejected her
 advances. On this she cursed
[]
 the youth, who in return cursed her that she should become the wife of
 a Kṣatriya (See कच.) Once upon a time Devayānī and her companion
 Śarmiṣṭhā, the daughter of Vṛṣaparvan, the king of the Daityas,
 went to bathe keeping their clothes on the shore. But the god Wind changed
 their clothes, and when they were dressed they began to quarrel about
 the change until Śarmiṣṭhā, so far lost her temper that she, slapped
 Devayānīʼs face, and threw her into a well. There she remained until
 she was seen and rescued by Yayāti, who, with the consent of her father,
 married her, and Śarmiṣṭhā became her servant as a recompense for
 her insulting conduct towards her. Devayānī lived happily with Yayāti
 for some years and bore him two sons, Yadu and Turvasu. Subsequently her
 husband became enamoured of Śarmiṣṭhā, and Devayānī, feeling herself
 aggrieved, abruptly left her husband and went home to her father, who
 at her request condemned Yayāti with the infirmity of old age; see Yayāti also.]

—2 Derived from a god.
—3 Virtuous, pious.
देविल a. Righteous, virtuous, divine.
देवितव्य a. To be gambled.
देवितव्य + .{@-व्यम्@} Gambling.
देवितृ, देविन् m. A gamester; Mb. 3. 252. 50.
देवितृ, देविन् m. A gamester; Mb. 3. 252. 50.

—1 A female deity, a goddess.
—2 N. of Durgā.
—3 N. of Sarasvatī.
—4 N. of Sāvitrī.
—5 A queen, especially a crowned queen (अग्रमहिषी who has undergone
 the consecration along with her husband); प्रेष्यभावेन नामेयं देवीशब्दक्षमा
 सती । स्नायीयवस्त्रक्रियया पत्त्रोर्णं वोपयुज्यते
[]
 M. 5. 12; देवीभावं गमिता परिवारपदं कथं भजत्येषा K. P. 10.
—6 A respectful title applied to a lady of the first rank.
—7 A kind of bird (श्यामा).
—8 A particular supernatural power (कुण्डलिनी).

देवी + -कोटः
—1 the city of Bāṇa (शोणितपुर).
—2 Devikotta (on the Coromandel coast).

देवी + -गृहम्
—1 the temple of a goddess.
—2 the apartment of a queen.
देवी + -पुराणम् N. of an Upapurāṇa.
देवी + -भागवतम् N. of an Upapurāṇa.
देवी + -भावः the dignity of a queen.
देवी + -सूक्तम् a Sūkta addressed to Devī.

देवृ m. [दिव्-ऋ]
—1 A husbandʼs brother (especially younger).
—2 The husband of a woman previously married (?).
देवेशयः An epithet of Viṣṇu.
देव्यम् Divine dignity, god-head.
